summary: Flat pancake bipolar stepper motor with a square body of about 50 x 50 mm and a single 5 mm diameter, 5 mm long output shaft centered on the front face. The shaft axis is Z. The front plate has four corner mounting holes on a 41 mm square pattern, and the lead wires exit from one side of the body.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front mounting face of the square body, with the 4 corner holes on a 41 x 41 mm pattern. The 5 mm shaft projects from its center, ending at z = +10.5.
Rear face of the body, opposite the shaft. The 16 mm body spans z = -10.5 to +5.5.

notes: The 50 mm square, the 41 mm hole spacing, the M2.5 hole size, and the 5 mm shaft diameter and length come from the drawing. The 16 mm body height and 21 mm overall height come from the product text, which is unverified. The drawing's body length label L is not given numerically, so I took it as 16 mm. The 5±1 mm feature on the drawing is not clearly identified, so I did not model it. The hole depth is not stated, so through is false. The corners appear chamfered, with a 66.5 mm diagonal, but I did not model that. The lead wires are 300 mm minimum, exit from one side, and are not included in the bounds.
